visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Return the Pointer Instead of Using a Global
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A global pointer receives the result of choose. Return the chosen pointer from the function instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A function that returns its result is easier to follow than one that leaves it in a global variable, and it can be used inside an expression. Only return pointers to data that outlives the call, like these caller variables.
